about: Round 3, your notes applied: now OPENS on “so I’m just gonna try to lag her up there and get a nice par tap in”. “Like I said, we’re pretty DC of the G” is split off at your own cut and moved to 3rd. Order (28 s): 1) lag her up there / par tap in (orange) 2) drive straight up with the full tracer → “and they call that an elephant’s ass” → “my lips are so dry” (green polo) 3) “like I said, we’re pretty DC of the G” (orange) 4) “a little pause at the top, a little pump pump” (green pinstripe) 5) “just a little bump and roll” (orange). The on-screen line “can you tell I was not formally trained in golf?” now sits in white rounded bubbles with black text so it can’t be mistaken for your captions. Every shot whole, swearing kept, one full-quality export from your originals. Covers unchanged.
